title: Sensory & Consumer Scientist
description:
Sensory & Consumer Scientist


The Sensory & Consumer Scientist leads sensory and consumer research for the EMEA Wet Flavour Solutions portfolio, supporting condiment innovation, optimisation, quality improvement and customer projects from concept through launch. Partnering with R&D, Commercial, Marketing and Quality teams, the role translates robust scientific insights into clear, actionable recommendations that enable confident business decisions.





MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Partnering:

  • Design, execute and interpret fit-for-purpose sensory and consumer research to support product development, renovation, cost optimisation, quality improvement and de-risking initiatives.
  • Present clear findings and recommendations that help cross-functional teams make informed product and commercial decisions.



Customer and Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Advise R&D, Commercial and Marketing stakeholders, and where appropriate customers, on suitable research methodologies.
  • Support customer presentations, technical discussions, proposals and research plans, while delivering sensory and consumer science training to build understanding and capability.



Sensory and Consumer Science Excellence:

  • Apply qualitative and quantitative methodologies, including focus groups, central location tests and surveys, in line with recognised standards and best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement in research approaches, contribute to the EMEA and Global Sensory & Consumer Science community, and support data governance and stewardship for the

Wet portfolio.



CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • Degree in Sensory & Consumer Science, Food Science and related discipline.
  • Relevant experience in sensory and consumer science within FMCG (food preferrably) or B2B.
  • Proven ability to independently design and manage end-to-end research programmes.
  • Strong statistical analysis capability with experience interpreting complex datasets.
  • Confident presenter, able to communicate technical findings to cross-functional and customer stakeholders.
  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Effective influencer and collaborative team player, comfortable working across multicultural environments.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and sensory/consumer software (e.g. Compusense or equivalent).
